item.title: Krakow gunman dies in hospital after killing six and injuring 15

item.title: Pre-Christmas shoppers warned of dodgy discounts as Black Friday sales kick off
item.description: Bogus "countdown timers", false "storewide" discount claims and misleading price comparisons are in the spotlight as the consumer watchdog cracks down this sales season.

item.title: Russell Brand jailed for more than 10 years for rape and sexual assault
item.description: Russell Brand was found guilty last week of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault relating to four women between 2004 and 2009.

item.title: COP31 summit targets major electrification push as 1.5C goal slips away
item.description: The climate summit will push for nations around the world to electrify their energy faster and move away from fossil fuels, as Chris Bowen predicts global temperatures will rise to 2.6 degrees above pre-industrial levels.

item.title: Pope draws record Buenos Aires crowd after rebuking Milei over austerity
item.description: More than 2.5 million worshippers attend the pontiff's Mass in the Argentinian capital, with some camping overnight to get a glimpse of the Catholic leader.

item.title: Queensland security guard who fought for Russia against Ukraine missing, feared dead
item.description: Daryl "Dundee" Fladung was recruited to fight for Russia while playing video games at home in outback Queensland. Ten days after posting about joining the front line, he went missing.

item.description: Hobart City Council's newly elected councillors have been formally sworn in. New Lord Mayor Charles Wooley says he wants to be a "people's mayor".
